title.narrative: Program för stöd till civilsamhället i Ukraina 2025-2027

The contribution is a Norad-Sida collaboration to increase and broaden the support to the Ukrainian civil society. The aim is to reach different types of organisations, be broad in its geographic and thematic scoop, and reach out to prioritised groups. The programme will contribute to grants, capacity building, research and networking. Implementing partners are International Renaissance Foundation (IRF) and Ednannia.

title.narrative: Avtal Norad avseende stöd till CSO i Ukraina
Beslut Norad stöd till CSO i Ukraina

description.narrative:
Results from 2025: 363 organisations were supported, 80 million SEK
Ednannia: During 2025, 295 organisations were supported through 336 grants and support - institutional, core, veteran grants, recovery, media (communication), research and advocacy grants. Support has also been give in the form of mentoring and networking as well as preparation for CSO inclusion and voice in the Ukraine Recovery Conference in Gdansk 2026.
The total cost was 43 MSEK.
IRF: 68 CSOs strengthened through grants and capacity development through 29 institutional and 40 small grants. 3,732 beneficiaries were reached, primarily from vulnerable groups. 236 policy and research outputs were produced.
The total cost was 37 MSEK
